text: Evidence 2026-08-03: added public-path StructuralFirstLevelScenarioSuite with one ScenarioResult per S07, S10, and S16. S07 builds the 2x2 event model through FmriModelBuilder and compiles structural simple, interaction, and basis-omnibus hypotheses. S10 obtains explicit HRF window-mean weights with units and discretization receipts, binds them to semantic basis elements, and checks nonlinear peak latency remains a separate value. S16 duplicates columns while preserving schema identity and checks estimable row-space sums versus typed non-estimable components. The suite passes 3/3 JVM and 3/3 Scala.js; full first-level gate passes fit 167/167 JVM and 159/159 JS. Remaining criterion caveats: S07 currently checks compilation/estimability and finite planted-response fits but not effect-size assertions; S10 does not yet exercise FIR-window and derivative/canonical alternatives in one scenario; S16 does not yet include empty-cell and all-zero-modulator branches; independent R/Nilearn design-oracle comparison remains separate from this acceptance slice. Keep issue open for those expansions.
